title: Jellyfish UAP explained as a group of drones

tellings.quote: these drones now, the the jellyfish UAP looks to be a group of drones. The drones are interconnected, you know, Bluetooth or whatever, and they're coordinated.

related.note: Same jellyfish-shaped UAP as Corbell's Iraq video, but this telling explains it as a coordinated group of drones rather than an unexplained UFO.

plain: A video of a "jellyfish" UAP (the newer official term for a UFO, an unidentified anomalous phenomenon) is really just a group of drones flying together, according to the well-known skeptic Michael Shermer. He tells Michels the drones look "interconnected, you know, Bluetooth or whatever," and "coordinated," giving an ordinary explanation for footage that others present as something unknown.
